items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Shields joined at... I asked him, how would you like to come with us?... Shields was with us then on.

ctx.x: And your clarinet changed too, didn't it? Somewhere around there.

At the Casino Gardens later. I had a little trouble at managing the band and paying them off. They were allowed, two of them were allowed to, well we all were allowed if we wished, to sign tabs up at the bar upstairs. Naturally some of them abused it. One of them said I didn't, said he didn't owe a certain amount of money. And I was holding the bag for four dollars, which I didn't like. So I thought and devised a way of getting this money, this four dollars back. Because I didn't like losing it. There was no…
Who was the clarinet between Shields and Nunes, if any? Was there anybody in between? Nobody?
